response.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM per_event) SELECT p.link_to_event, p.cnt, CAST(p.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM per_event p JOIN tot t ON t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Rows with NULL link_to_event, if any, form their own group (as GROUP BY does) and are counted in the total; the request says to group by link_to_event without filtering.
Ties in share are broken arbitrarily since no tiebreaker was specified.
